response.description:
In late September 2026, the following updates and
enhancements were made to Azure SQL:  
 Database
     Hub in Microsoft Fabric is a unified experience for discovering, managing,
     monitoring, and optimizing databases across SQL Server, Azure SQL,
     PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB, and Fabric SQL. By bringing AI-powered
     insights and agents into a single control plane, Database Hub simplifies
     database operations and helps you modernize your data estate.  
 You
     can now increase the number of databases allowed in a Hyperscale Elastic
     pool to 50.  
 Azure
     SQL Database now supports local time zones, enabling applications to
     operate using a configured time zone without requiring custom logic or
     workarounds.  
 The
     MSSQL extension’s modernized landing page makes it easier to discover
     features and get started quickly.   
 You
     can now use a single Azure SQL Managed Instance link to replicate multiple
     databases from SQL Server Always On Availability Groups to Azure SQL
     Managed Instance.  Learn more: Data Hub in Microsoft Fabric   Increased
databases in Hyperscale Elastic pool  Local time zones in Azure SQL
Database  MSSQL extension modernized
landing page Single Azure SQL Managed
Instance link to replicate multiple databases
response.title: Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for late-September 2026
